implementation.note: Alpha bounds derived from final baked atlas.

architecture.note: Shared per-prototype geometry retains both draw materials and azimuth selection.

native_api.note: Adapter selects contour mode during prototype creation.

skill.note: Benchmark-only tuning in the native test.

mcp.note: No editable operation or saved setting.

studio.note: Prototype-time experiment has no authored Studio property.

inspector.note: Comparison switches only in native prototype construction.

persistence.note: Derived geometry carries no serialized state.

performance.note: Both contours reduce coverage. On the 288-tree M3 Ultra grove, median GPU time rises by 2.7% for three bands and 32.6% for eight bands. Keep opt-in. Follow-up trial: one alpha bounding box per layer on a long-trunk palm at multiple distances and azimuths.

platforms.note: Measured arm64 Metal only. Other targets untested.

dependencies.note: Uses existing model geometry, texture and Metal test target.

headless.note: Render-only comparison with CPU geometry tests.

examples.note: The offscreen grove exercises all three geometry modes.

tests.note: CPU and Metal checks repeated three times on the tested SHA.

handoff.note: Includes workload, limitations, tested SHA and next step.

publishing.note: No visual feature release. Real hardware captures accompany the experiment.
